messages:
Noah V.: hey all, first day—trying to finish SSO but Okta keeps showing a 'Device consent required' banner and when I click it nothing happens. 1Password says my invite is active but I can't SSO into slack/github. anyone seen this?
Taylor (IT): welcome Noah! which browser/os? sometimes mac privacy or an extension blocks the consent flow.
Noah V.: macbook pro m2, macOS 13, Safari. no unusual extensions. clicked the banner twice and it just reloads the page.
Onboard Bot: New hire provisioning: okta user created; 1password invite sent; Google Workspace provision pending final sync. If device consent fails, IT will attempt session clear and re-provision.
Taylor (IT): thanks. can you try (1) opening Safari private mode, (2) disable content blockers for okta.com, (3) if still broken try Chrome incognito. i'll also clear your Okta session on our side.
Noah V.: tried Safari private, same. switched to Chrome incognito and consent dialog appeared, but when I approve it says 'consent accepted' then Slack still shows 'SSO required'.
Taylor (IT): hm ok i'm seeing a mismatch in the timestamp for your provisioned attributes in our logs—looks like the Google Workspace sync to Okta didn't complete. i'm triggering a manual user sync and clearing cached sessions for your user now.
Taylor (IT): (system) manual sync and session clear completed for noah.v@redwood.dev. try logging into Slack again, and open 1Password app to accept the device link after.
Noah V.: logged into Slack successfully now! 1Password web SSO worked after that too. settings show my device registered. thank you!
Syd (People Ops): congrats and welcome aboard, Noah! sorry for the friction on day one. we'll follow up with a quick check-in. :wave:
Noah V.: all good, appreciate the rapid help. closing out.
